name: Habitat for Humanity International
summary: Builds, repairs and finances homes with low-income families through about 984 US affiliates and national organisations in more than 60 countries; buyers repay affordable mortgages.

lines.label: US affiliates: homes built and sold, repairs and disaster recovery
lines.source: https://www.habitat.org/media/36766/download (audited consolidated statements of activities, FY2025, p. 6): U.S. affiliates programme services $184,691 thousand, less about $2 million of US advocacy booked there (facts/habitat_for_humanity.json). Public awareness and education is the awareness programme below.

lines.label: International programme: housing with national organisations and market development
lines.source: https://www.habitat.org/media/36766/download (audited consolidated statements of activities, FY2025, p. 6): international affiliates programme services $75,514 thousand, less about $1.5 million of Home Equals advocacy booked there (facts/habitat_for_humanity.json).

lines.label: Public awareness, education and housing-policy advocacy
lines.source: https://www.habitat.org/media/36766/download (audited consolidated statements of activities, FY2025, p. 6): public awareness and education $24,292 thousand, plus about $3.5 million of advocacy booked in the US and international programme lines (facts/habitat_for_humanity.json) = $27,792 thousand.
